articles.summary: WPP announced today that WPP Media has been named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Media Management Services, Q4 2026, receiving the highest scores possible in criteria including communications strategy, technology and solutions implementation and media buying.
articles.title: WPP Media named a Leader in Media Management Services, Q4 2026 evaluation by independent research firm

articles.summary: Frank-Michael "FM" Schmidt has decided to step down as CEO of the Scholz & Friends Family at the end of 2026 after 23 years at the agency, 18 of them as CEO.
articles.title: FM Schmidt decides to step down after 23 years leading Scholz & Friends
